profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Roblox
profile.summary:
Hi! My name is Jared Gutierrez and I'm a graduate from the University of California, Berkeley where I obtained my degree in Computer Science. I am currently an Engineer at Roblox on the Content Platform team. My prior experience includes Software Engineering at Brex, Google, Airbnb, and Nvidia, along with Product Management at B/C startups

Don't hesitate to reach out!
